title: Reinforcement in Seismic Design Category C or D.
officialText:
Where a structure is assigned to Seismic Design Category C or D
in accordance with Section 1613, the corresponding requirements of Sections 1810.1.2.3 through 1810.1.2.5 shall be
met.
